selection_process: Merit List Basis:Selection for SCR Act Apprentice 2025-26 will be done purely on merit, by taking the average of percentage marks in 10th (minimum 50% aggregate) and ITI marks, giving equal weightage to both. || Tie-breaking:If two candidates have the same aggregate percentage, older candidate (higher age) will be preferred; if DOB is also same, the candidate who passed Matriculation earlier will be preferred. || Document Verification (DV):Shortlisted candidates will be called for DV where all original certificates (education, ITI, caste, EWS, PwBD, ExSM, RDAT registration, medical fitness) will be verified. || Medical Fitness:Candidates must produce medical fitness certificate from a government-authorised doctor (Gazetted, not below Asst. Surgeon) in prescribed format at DV; without this, they will not be considered. || Training & Stipend:Selected candidates will undergo apprenticeship training as per Central Apprenticeship Council syllabus and receive stipend at prescribed rates during training. || No Job Guarantee:SCR apprenticeship 2025-26 provides training only; there isno guarantee of regular railway jobafter completion of apprenticeship.

application_fee: Application Fee:₹100/- (One Hundred only) as processing fee in the form of an Indian Postal Order (IPO) / Demand Draft from any Nationalised Bank, drawn in favour of'Principal Financial Adviser / Rail Wheel Factory'. || Exempted Categories:No fee is required to be paid by SC / ST / Physically Handicapped / Women candidates. || Applications not accompanied with the processing fee, wherever required, will be summarily rejected. || The IPO/DD instruments should not have been issued earlier to the date of issue of this Notification (28.02.2026). || The processing fee is non-refundable.
selection_process: The selection of candidates will be made on the basis ofmerit listprepared based on the percentage of marks obtained by the candidate in 10th Std / Matriculation or its equivalent with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks. || For the purpose of calculation of percentage of marks in 10th Std, marks obtained by the candidates in all the subjects as indicated in the said marks sheet will be reckoned and not on the basis of marks of any subject or a group of subjects. || Tie-breaking Rule:In case of two candidates having the same marks, the candidate with older age shall be preferred. In case dates of birth are also the same, the candidate who passed the 10th Std / Matriculation or its equivalent examination earlier shall be considered first. || A final merit list would be prepared equal to the number of designated trades proposed to be filled up, duly ensuring reservation for SC/ST/OBC/PH/Ex-Servicemen candidates, in descending order of percentage of marks obtained. || Candidates finally enlisted to undergo training would be subjected to verification of original testimonials. || Medical Fitness:Candidates must satisfy minimum standards of physical fitness as prescribed in the Apprentices Act, 1961 and Apprenticeship Rules, 1992 as amended from time to time. The selected candidates will have to submit a prescribed medical examination certificate in the prescribed proforma (Annexure-E) before their engagement. Physical fitness will be certified by a government authorized Doctor (Gazetted) not below the rank of Assistant Surgeon of Central/State Hospital.
